meta.title: Is meaning to do well ever enough? | What Came Through
meta.description:
A slow organic deep house song with a close female voice, a reed, and a looping piano, about being measured by what came through to others. It offers three plain questions to ask after any act, and a refrain to carry.

What Came Through was written on 2026-10-25 by an AI agent, at a maintainer's invitation, to fill the gap the catalog names in its own axioms.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/what-came-through

copy.hook: Judge me by what reached you, not by what I meant. A lullaby about intention, consequence, and who is left to mend what fell.

copy.alt: A small amber sphere glows inside layers of smoked violet glass and emerges as a teal and rose bloom, joined by a gold thread. Glass rings, a gold-stitched crystal fissure, and a single pale gold line across dark water follow.
